option_relations.rationale: The option describes 'Klebsiella pneumoniae liver abscess syndrome', which is equivalent to the leaf 'Klebsiella pneumoniae Liver Abscess'. The additional 'with septic emboli' describes a complication of the disease.
The option specifies 'Klebsiella oxytoca' as the causative agent, while the leaf specifies 'Klebsiella pneumoniae'. These are different species.
An iliopsoas abscess can be a metastatic complication of a Klebsiella pneumoniae liver abscess, as suggested by the vignette's findings of a low-density area of left-sided iliopsoas muscle swelling.

The option describes 'Invasive Klebsiella pneumoniae liver abscess syndrome', which is equivalent to the leaf 'Klebsiella pneumoniae Liver Abscess'. The 'with metastatic spread' describes a characteristic feature of this syndrome.
